edits.old:
h="$(git -C "$root" hash-object -- "$f")" || exit 1
          # The executable bit is part of what git commits; hash-object ignores it.
          mode=644; if [ -x "$root/$f" ]; then mode=755; fi
          record F "$f" "$mode" "$h" || exit 1
edits.new:
h="$(git -C "$root" hash-object -- "$f")" || exit 1
          record F "$f" "$h" || exit 1
